On Aug. 7, Abelardo de la Espriella will take office as Colombia's newest
president, in a major rightwards shift from Gustavo Petro's outgoing leftist
administration.

As Colombia continues to grapple with [paramilitary
violence](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jun/20/colombia-presidential-
election-paramilitary-militia-runoff), De la Espriella, who has dubbed himself
"The Tiger," has proposed a hard-line approach backed by the likes of [Javier
Milei](https://www.democrata.es/en/international/milei-expresses-his-support-
for-de-la-espriella-ahead-of-the-presidential-runoff-in-colombia/) and [Donald
Trump](https://x.com/TrumpTruthOnX/status/2061971523188199513).

So as another controversial and outspoken right-winger takes
[power](https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/de-la-espriella-win-colombia-
cements-latin-americas-rightward-shift-2026-06-22/) in South America, here are
11 things you need to know about Abelardo de la Espriella.

### **1\. He Has No Government Experience**

Before launching his presidential campaign, De la Espriella was a lawyer and
businessman. He will be the first modern Colombian president elected with no
prior political experience.

### **2\. He 's Made a Brand of Flaunting His Wealth**

Often seen wearing tailored suits, fedoras, and fancy watches, De la Espriella
has hinged his public persona on his millionaire status. He self-produced a
covers album, including a version of Frank Sinatra's 'My Way' with an
accompanying video in which he was
[shown](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=h_OLZIQEG1Y) eating sushi on a private
jet. For those interested in living the De la Espriella lifestyle, his
[website](https://delaespriellastyle.com/) sells everything from his own rum
and wine brands to luxury suit jackets.
